subject.title: fix(plugins): prevent npm 12 metadata failures from disabling healthy plugins

question: Should the canonical fix be this broader PR after live CLI proof, or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107063 with the sibling update-check parser handled separately?
rationale: Both branches address the destructive state transition, but only this PR includes the sibling parser fix while the competing PR claims stronger direct CLI proof; selecting ownership requires maintainer judgment before either branch lands.

options.title: Use this broader PR

options.title: Use the narrower PR
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107063 for state preservation and move the update-check singleton-array normalization into a separate focused change.
